svg.title: BankResilience animated system architecture
svg.desc: Operator-confirmed experiments flow through FastAPI, baseline observation, Gemini advice, deterministic safety, fixed Docker adapters, and verification. Banking traffic flows independently through routing guards to primary or qualified standby services sharing databases. Evidence is persisted, scored, ranked and exported. Moving markers illustrate direction rather than live state.
svg.text: AI investigates. Policy authorizes. Guards protect traffic. Measurements verify recovery.
Gemini proposes actions; deterministic controllers own injection, safety, recovery and numeric scores.
Planner recommends; the operator confirms. Suites use fixed orders. Standby failover is independent of Gemini.
Moving markers illustrate flow, not live telemetry. Blue: requests · Mint: evidence / standby · Purple: AI advice · Amber: controlled mutation.
